title: FlowExtract API: Web Data Extraction APIs & Scrapers
h1: Data extraction APIs for the sites you need
metaDescription: Ready-made scrapers and data extraction APIs for real estate, e-commerce, ads, social media, video and search: paste a link, get JSON, CSV or Excel.
intro: FlowExtract API builds ready-to-run scrapers on the Apify platform. Paste a link from the site you need, start the run, and get clean JSON, CSV or Excel, or call it as an API from your own code.
